LESSON: THE NATIONAL

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social
Topic 2.1.5: The National

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The National. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate respect for the lowering the National Flag the Kenya National Kenya national flag as a 
2. Appreciate the National flag as a symbol for national unity. guardians the importance of the National flag of Kenya

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THE NATIONAL
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
The National helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: THE NATIONAL
Study The National like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Demonstrate respect for the lowering the National Flag the Kenya National Kenya national flag as a 

What this means
In this part you learn to demonstrate respect for the lowering the National Flag the Kenya National Kenya national flag as a . You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: demonstrate respect for the lowering the National Flag the Kenya National Kenya national flag as a .
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “The National” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can demonstrate respect for the lowering the National Flag the Kenya National Kenya national flag as a . Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the National flag as a symbol for national unity. guardians the importance of the National flag of Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to Appreciate the National flag as a symbol for national unity. guardians the importance of the National flag of Kenya. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Appreciate the National flag as a symbol for national unity. guardians the importance of the National flag of Kenya.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why The National matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Appreciate the National flag as a symbol for national unity. guardians the importance of the National flag of Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what The National is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “The National” around your school. (skill: demonstrate respect for the lowering the National Flag the Kenya National Kenya national flag as a )

Example 2: Say why The National matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: Appreciate the National flag as a symbol for national unity. guardians the importance of the National flag of Kenya)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach The National to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: demonstrate respect for the lowering the National Flag the Kenya National Kenya national flag as a .
3. Practise this skill: Appreciate the National flag as a symbol for national unity. guardians the importance of the National flag of Kenya.
4. Make one local Kenya example of The National from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for The National: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study The National?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what The National means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: demonstrate respect for the lowering the National Flag the Kenya National Kenya national flag as a .
5. Be able to: Appreciate the National flag as a symbol for national unity. guardians the importance of the National flag of Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
